repositories.name: nginx-vod-module
repositories.notes: Full history of dio-az/nginx-vod-module (all branches; tags v1.x) plus Kaltura's branches from StayLive under kaltura/*. Kaltura's tags 1.0-1.33 are identical (same tag objects and commits) in both originals; 1.31 = 6c305a78, last verified Kaltura commit 26f0687 is in main. The build fetches the v1.9.1 archive from this repo's release files, not from this repository.

debian.notes: Debian packages are not copied: the builds read Debian's dated archive frozen at this time, so every build gets the same package versions.
